description: Delete one space: records the deletion in TaskForge/Settings/space-deletions.json, then removes the space file (a removed file alone is restored by the app). Other devices drop the space when the deletion reaches them; a device that edits or saves the space before then can bring it back, as with a delete made in the app. Tasks are never touched. dry_run:true reports what would be deleted without writing.

dry_run.description: Report what would be deleted without writing.

space.description: The space to delete (id, slug or name).

name: delete_space
